    return (p[0]+p[1]*L+p[2]*t+p[3]*t**2+p[4]*t**3+p[5]*t**2/P
            +p[6]*P*L*t**3+p[7]*L*t/P+p[8]*P*L+p[9]*P**2*L*t**3)
